app_link_not_ready: The link to this machine is not ready
app_no_client_token: No client token: other machines cannot be reached
app_machine_took_back: {name} took its shell back: the connection to it is gone
app_session_gone: That session is gone: it ended elsewhere, so its tab is closed.
app_service_start_failed: The local service failed to start ({reason}): browsers and phones cannot connect. The terminals in this window are unaffected.
app_released_lease: Control released: now watching read-only, {name} keeps running in the background
app_control_off: This machine does not allow other clients to control it: turn it on in its Settings → Service → Allow control.
reach_body: This window asks the relay for a short-lived takeover token with this machine's device secret, and the relay checks that the machine is enrolled. With one, every machine on the same relay can be driven from here.
reach_failed: The relay did not mint a takeover token: {reason}
tab_close_tip: Close the tab and end this session's process
action_release_tip: Release control: watch read-only while the terminal keeps running in the background
banner_ended: The session has exited; its last lines can still be read.
banner_readonly_holder: Read-only: this session is controlled by {holder}
action_take_over_tip: Take over input: gain keyboard access to type in the terminal
action_take_back_tip: Take back control: this machine types again
empty_service_off: The local service is off. Open Settings to start it again.
empty_remote_none: {name} has no sessions yet. Start one, or open one from another client and look again.
empty_sidebar_sessions: {count} sessions in the sidebar. Pick one, or start a new terminal.
empty_hint: Press + in the sidebar to open a terminal, or pick a session from a machine group above.
status_take_back_tip: This machine takes back control: keyboard input restored
status_take_over_tip: Take over input: gain keyboard access (the other side goes read-only)
composer_fill_tip: Put it back in the field
composer_send_tip: Send this line to the terminal ({mod}↵)
composer_placeholder: Type a command, Enter sends it (Shift+Enter for a new line)
lease_outcome_back: {holder} goes read-only and keeps watching this terminal.
lease_outcome_over: Taking over notifies {holder}, who goes read-only.
lease_tip_over: Take over input: gain keyboard access ({holder} goes read-only)
lease_tip_back: Take back control: this machine types again ({holder} goes read-only)
lease_tip_free: With control you can type in the terminal
lease_outcome_free: Take control and you can keep typing.
lease_readonly_note: Read-only right now: your typing does not reach the shell.
lease_stay_tip: Watch the screen live without sending keyboard input
update_daily_note: Asks once a day in the background; with automatic download on, the next launch is the new version.
update_found_note: When a new version appears a window lists its notes, with install, remind me later and skip this version.
update_unavailable_note: This build cannot update itself: a development build, or one installed by a package manager (.deb and the like), which owns updating. Builds from the installer or tar.gz update themselves.
update_source_note: Update source: the official releases of github.com/CarlOpenLab/beacon, signed and verified.
settings_font_note: The font and size apply to the terminals already open in this window too.
settings_viewer_fit_note: While watching another machine's terminal read-only, shrink its whole screen to fit the pane instead of cutting off the right edge. Controlling is never scaled.
settings_language_note: The interface language applies at once; what language your programs use is their own business.
settings_ca_empty_hint: Leave empty to use the system trust store
settings_ca_note_empty: A relay with a self-signed certificate needs this field; one signed by a public CA can leave it empty.
settings_ca_invalid: This is not a valid certificate file: {reason}
settings_relay_help: The address looks like wss://relay.example/relay/agent. When the relay uses a self-signed or private CA certificate, click Get from server to fetch and pin it, or Choose file… to point at a PEM you already downloaded. Then click Apply. Once joined, browsers and phones on the same relay can open this machine's sessions.
settings_token_help: Once joined, this machine trades its device secret for a short-lived takeover token (15 minutes by default), which finds the other machines on the same relay and takes over their sessions — no password to type here. An expiring token is replaced automatically.
settings_reach_ready_left: ● Other machines on this relay can be taken over (takeover token valid for {left})
settings_reach_ready: ● Other machines on this relay can be taken over
settings_reach_failed: ○ The takeover link did not come up: {reason}
settings_reach_asking: ○ Asking the relay for a takeover token…
settings_ca_need_url: Fill in the public address above first, then get the certificate from the server.
settings_server_desc: Turning this on opens a port that listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The first time macOS sees a listening program it asks once whether to allow incoming connections; click allow and it never asks again.
settings_control_desc: With it off, other clients can still watch but cannot take over.
settings_server_url_line: A browser on this machine can open {url} and see the same sessions as this window.
settings_server_off_line: The local service is off: no port for browsers. The window works as usual and running terminals do not stop.
settings_control_on_line: Other clients may take over this machine's terminals: a browser, a phone, or another computer on the same relay. Taking control back is always one click on this machine.
settings_control_off_line: Other clients can only watch read-only: no taking over, and no starting terminals on this machine. This machine's own window is unaffected.
settings_relay_failed: The relay link did not come up: {reason}
settings_token_failed: The takeover token was not granted: {reason}
settings_client_failed: The client link did not drop: {reason}
settings_server_failed: The local service did not start: {reason}

@machine_list_sep.description: Between a machine's name and its state when spoken aloud. A full-width comma in Chinese, a comma and a space in English.

machine_note_local_only: This machine only: join a relay in Settings → Remote and the other machines on it appear here.
machine_note_no_token: Picking another machine asks the relay for a short-lived takeover token; why it was not minted is in Settings → Remote.
machine_note_ready: Pick a machine to switch to it: it becomes what the Sessions panel above is about.

@session_new_on_machine.description: The new-terminal button at the right of a machine's group.

@session_refresh_machine.description: The refresh button at the right of a machine's group: asks that machine for its session list again.

@status_creating.description: The status bar, while a shell is on its way.

@settings_lang_system.description: The language field's entry that follows the languages the system says the person reads.

action_jump_attention: Jump to the session needing you
action_hide_machine: Hide this machine from the sidebar

@action_hide_machine.description: A machine header's context menu item: take the whole machine out of the sidebar.

@notify_needs_you_title.description: Beacon UI: notify needs you title

@settings_pane_sidebar.description: The settings pane with the machines the sidebar shows.

@settings_sidebar_machines.description: The sidebar settings group that lists every machine.

settings_sidebar_note: Hidden machines leave the sidebar; a machine appears by itself while a session on it needs you.

@settings_sidebar_note.description: The line under the sidebar machine switches, explaining the exception.

@settings_sidebar_toggle.description: A machine's sidebar switch, read by assistive technology.

settings_translucent_note: Let the desktop show through a little

@sidebar_others.description: The sidebar row that holds the machines with no sessions, above their folded headers.

@sidebar_none_visible.description: The sidebar's empty state, when no machine has a header.

@sidebar_restore_machines.description: The sidebar's empty state row that opens the sidebar settings.

sidebar_no_sessions: No sessions yet. Press + to open a terminal.

@sidebar_nothing_needs_you.description: Beacon UI: sidebar nothing needs you

@status_needs_sign_in.description: Beacon UI: status needs sign in

@workspace_panes.description: A split's row in the sidebar: how many panes it holds.

notify_body_waiting: This session is waiting for you
settings_notify_waiting: Notify when a session needs you
settings_dock_badge: Show the count on the Dock icon
settings_notify_note: Only when the window is not in front, or the session is not the one on screen.
settings_keys_note: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want. Esc cancels, ⌫ clears it.
settings_keys_conflict: That key is already used by “{action}”

@settings_keys_clear.description: The × beside a shortcut on the keyboard page.

@window_minimize.description: The app-drawn window controls (Windows and Linux).

@window_maximize.description: The app-drawn window controls (Windows and Linux).

@window_restore.description: The app-drawn window controls (Windows and Linux).

@window_close.description: The app-drawn window controls (Windows and Linux).

settings_diag_note: When a pane stays empty, a machine cannot be reached, or a session will not open, send this log: it records every terminal from attach to first byte, and what the machines and links were doing at the time.
settings_diag_level_note: Detailed records attaches, replays and the routing of every frame; output is summarised every 256 KB, so the file does not grow with a shell's output.
settings_diag_no_file: The log is not open (the startup error is on the console)
app_machine_offline: {name} is offline: its last sessions are still listed, and will open once it is back
app_terminal_unavailable: The terminal view could not be created ({reason}); see the log under Settings → Diagnostics
paste_read_only: Read-only: take control of this terminal first
paste_unsupported: The Beacon on this machine is too old to receive files
attach_truncated: You were away too long: the screen may be incomplete (latest output replayed)

@rail_hidden_needs.description: The machine rail's edge dot: machines scrolled out of sight that need you or failed.

@rail_hidden_failed.description: The machine rail's edge dot: machines scrolled out of sight that need you or failed.
